review_candidates.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Trilogy (Remote) - $800,000/year USD
review_candidates.description: Most finance executives inherit a system. You will redesign one, then decide where the capital goes. Trilogy is looking for the executive who can turn a portfolio of businesses into a capital allocation system: continuously ranking where the next dollar should go, backing those decisions with rigorous models, and moving capital toward its highest-return uses. You will own the calls that matter: fund or kill a business line; invest or hold; acquire or walk away; refinance or pay down debt. Every recommendation must connect strategy to cash, liquidity, covenants, risk, and enterprise value. Just as important, you will architect an AI-native finance function built to scale without decision bottlenecks. This does not mean sprinkling AI tools onto a traditional finance organization. You will redesign reporting, planning, controls, portfolio monitoring, and decision support around what AI and automation can now do. You won't need to personally build every workflow, but you must use AI deeply enough to know its edges: where it accelerates analysis, where it fails, and where expert judgment must take over. The result should be a smaller, more senior, higher-leverage finance organization rather than a growing pyramid of people and processes. You will operate directly with Trilogy's CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners, with personal accountability for the financial truth behind major decisions. This is an $800K W-2 salaried role for someone who has already earned credibility at serious financial scale and now wants the mandate to compound enterprise value across an entire portfolio. If you want your impact measured by the quality of your capital decisions and the financial system you leave behind, apply. What You Will Be Doing Allocating capital across the portfolio: Run capital and portfolio reviews, rank competing uses of capital on risk-adjusted return, and make clear fund, hold, restructure, exit, debt-paydown, or acquisition recommendations. Architecting an AI-native finance system: Redesign planning, reporting, consolidation, controls, portfolio monitoring, and financial workflows around AI, automation, and scalable systems rather than additional headcount. Driving investments and transactions: Build and defend the financial case for strategic investments, M&A, financing, and refinancing, including integrated models, downside scenarios, capital structure, covenant implications, and execution plans. Owning board and capital-partner communication: Give the CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners fast, quantified, defensible truth, with recommendations that make the decision and trade-offs explicit. Building a high-leverage finance leadership team: Set the bar for a small group of exceptional finance leaders while creating systems that allow new ventures and greater complexity to be absorbed without linear organizational growth. What You Won’t Be Doing Running finance as a reporting factory. Closing the books and producing audit workpapers are the Controller's responsibilities. Your job is to turn financial information into better capital decisions. Building a large finance organization to handle complexity. Scale should come from better systems, AI leverage, automation, and exceptional people, not layers of management. Adding AI as a superficial productivity tool. You will architect workflows around its real capabilities and limitations, which requires substantial firsthand use. Producing strategy decks without financial consequences. Major recommendations must carry the integrated model, downside case, capital implications, and execution guardrails behind them. Managing the board through narrative. The numbers, assumptions, risks, and recommended action should be clear enough to withstand scrutiny. Executive Vice President And Chief Financial Officer Key Responsibilities Build a durable, AI-native finance function that compounds enterprise value across Trilogy's portfolio by allocating capital to its highest-return uses and creating financial systems and controls that scale without decision bottlenecks. Basic Requirements Experience as the most senior finance decision-maker, or their direct deputy, for a business or portfolio with $100M+ in annual revenue across multiple legal entities. Personal ownership of major capital-allocation decisions, including the ability to explain what was funded, reduced, or rejected; the dollars involved; the trade-offs; and your recommendation. Decision ownership on at least one $25M+ closed M&A, financing, or refinancing transaction, with direct responsibility for negotiation, financing selection, board recommendation, or post-close integration. Direct experience presenting to and taking live questions from a board of directors. Ownership of an external audit relationship under US GAAP or IFRS, directly or through a Controller reporting to you. Hands-on experience with a true enterprise ERP such as SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent. Recent experience re-architecting a finance workflow around AI, with enough regular personal AI use to understand where the technology is reliable, where it is not, and how those boundaries should shape finance-system design. Ability to operate integrated 3-statement models and defend assumptions, downside scenarios, covenant math, capital structure, and recommendations under live questioning. Strong written and verbal English, with experience communicating directly with CEOs, boards, lenders, or capital partners. Located within the UTC−8 to UTC+3 time-zone range. Nice-to-have Requirements CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA, MBA, or comparable finance credential. Earlier career experience in private equity, investment banking, M&A, corporate finance, or another environment requiring rigorous modeling and high-stakes capital decisions. Experience rebuilding a finance function rather than simply inheriting and operating one. Experience across a portfolio, multi-entity, or PE-backed operating environment. About Trilogy Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses. Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud-based stack. Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds. There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you! Working with us This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $400 USD/hour, which equates to $800,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help-and-faqs for more details on this topic. Crossover Job Code: LJ-5852-EG-COUNTRY-ExecutiveViceP

review_candidates.description: Company Description Dimois Institute is a leading training organization based in Saudi Arabia, specializing in internationally accredited, high-quality professional development programs. The institute offers comprehensive courses across modern, in-demand fields such as personal development, business management, marketing and sales, technology, computing, and human resources. Programs are delivered by internationally qualified trainers with practical experience, using contemporary and effective training methodologies. Dimois Institute is committed to providing a motivating and comfortable learning environment with modern facilities and excellent educational resources. Quality standards and international accreditation are central to the institute’s identity, with a continuous focus on delivering training that meets global benchmarks. Role Description This is a full-time, hybrid Business Development Specialist (B2B) role based in Cairo, Egypt, with flexibility for partial work from home. The specialist will identify and develop new B2B opportunities, build and nurture relationships with corporate clients, and promote Dimois Institute’s training programs to organizations. Daily tasks include conducting market research, generating and qualifying leads, preparing and presenting proposals, and coordinating with internal teams to tailor solutions for client needs. The role also involves managing the sales pipeline, following up on inquiries, maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, and supporting contract negotiations. The specialist will collaborate with marketing and operations teams to align business development activities with the institute’s strategic goals and contribute to revenue growth. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Market Research capabilities to identify trends, assess opportunities, and support data-driven decisions. Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to build long-term client relationships and provide a professional client experience. Candidates should possess solid Lead Generation experience and B2B outreach skills to develop and expand the corporate client base. Relevant experience in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in education, training, or professional services. Ability to work in a hybrid model, manage time effectively, and handle multiple projects and deadlines. Proficiency in CRM systems, MS Office tools, and basic sales reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field is preferred. Strong negotiation, presentation, and networking skills; fluency in English and Arabic is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company The Kassenärztliche Vereinigung Westfalen-Lippe (KVWL) is a leading organization dedicated to the advancement of healthcare services within the Westfalen-Lippe region. With a focus on innovation and digital transformation, KVWL employs over 140 IT professionals from diverse disciplines to develop and implement cutting-edge digital solutions that enhance healthcare delivery. The organization operates a comprehensive full-service platform tailored for medical and psychotherapeutic professionals, as well as internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless and efficient healthcare management. KVWL is committed to fostering a modern, collaborative work environment that values agility, continuous learning, and technological excellence. As a stable and future-oriented employer, KVWL offers a dynamic workplace where employees can contribute to shaping the future of healthcare through innovative IT initiatives. About The Role We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) to join our IT department at our Dortmund location. In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting the digital transformation of healthcare services by managing and optimizing our billing and master data systems. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and evaluating billing-related data, administering and configuring existing database systems, and developing applications and interfaces to automate and streamline processes. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in database management, software development, and DevOps practices, with a passion for implementing innovative solutions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work within a modern, agile environment, contributing directly to the digitalization of the healthcare industry and improving service delivery for medical professionals and patients alike. Qualifications A successfully completed degree in computer science, business informatics, or a comparable IT-related qualification. Excellent knowledge of relational SQL databases and database design, particularly Oracle SQL and PostgreSQL, along with proficiency in PL/SQL. Familiarity with software development concepts and tools such as Scrum, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Domain-driven Design. Desirable skills include experience with NoSQL databases and backend development using Java or PowerShell. A passion for new technologies and a keen interest in working on challenging software projects. Strong motivation to shape and improve systems, analytical thinking, and a systematic, goal-oriented working style. Responsibilities Perform database analysis and data evaluation related to billing cases and other relevant datasets. Administer and configure existing billing and master data systems, with a focus on database management and optimization. Evaluate and implement new frameworks, libraries, and tools to enhance existing solutions and processes. Develop applications and interfaces aimed at automating workflows and improving operational efficiency. Ensure high code quality through regular team exchanges, code reviews, and automated testing procedures. Benefits Secure employment with a reputable organization in the healthcare sector. Work-life balance facilitated through flexible working hours, mobile work options, and home office opportunities. Comprehensive onboarding process to support your integration into the team. Numerous opportunities for professional development and continuous learning. Company-sponsored retirement plan, fully funded by the employer. Additional benefits such as asset-building allowances, employer subsidies for public transport tickets, and JobRad leasing options. Access to corporate discounts and a modern, ergonomic workplace environment. Participation in health management programs and wellness initiatives. Excellent accessibility via public transportation and ample parking facilities. On-site, KVWL-supported canteen offering high-quality meals and free beverages. Equal Opportunity We are committed to promoting equal opportunities and fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences, including those with migration backgrounds. Applicants with disabilities will be given special consideration if they meet the required qualifications. We believe that diversity enriches our organization and contributes to innovative and effective healthcare solutions.

review_candidates.title: iOS Engineer
review_candidates.description: Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region. Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA. Role Summary As a Middle iOS Engineer you will join a cross-functional product squad of engineers, a product manager and a designer. You will own features end to end, from grooming through to App Store release, and you will be part of the iOS chapter, which sets our standards for architecture, quality and tooling. We are rebuilding the app for iOS 26, so you will be shipping into a modern, modular SwiftUI codebase and shaping how the new experience is built. Key Responsibilities Build product features in SwiftUI, working with designers and product managers to deliver polished, accessible screens that support right-to-left Arabic layouts. Work within our architecture: MVVM with @Observable view models, an adapter layer between UI and business logic, Factory dependency injection and local Swift packages for UI, navigation, networking and tracking. Integrate with backend services through async/await networking and API connectors generated from OpenAPI specifications, including our backend-driven UI framework, where the server defines which sections a screen shows. Release features behind feature flags and A/B tests, and instrument them with analytics so product decisions are based on data. Write unit tests (XCTest and Swift Testing with generated mocks) and snapshot tests, and contribute to our end-to-end test suites. Take part in the release train: CI on GitHub Actions, fastlane, TestFlight and phased App Store rollouts, followed by monitoring crash and performance signals after each release. Review pull requests, write and discuss RFCs, and improve the performance, stability and developer experience of the app. Desired Experience 3+ years of professional iOS development, including at least one app shipped to the App Store and supported in production. Strong Swift and hands-on SwiftUI experience: state ownership (@State, @Binding, @Observable), view lifecycle (.task, onAppear), lists, forms and navigation flows. Solid experience with Swift Concurrency (async/await, tasks, actors) and working knowledge of Combine. A clear understanding of architecture and separation of concerns: MVVM or a similar pattern, the repository pattern, dependency injection, SOLID principles and code designed to be testable. A production mindset: safe code without force unwraps or fatalError shortcuts, proper loading, error and empty states, backward compatibility with older iOS versions, and attention to SwiftUI performance. The ability to explain trade-offs, for example how to persist data locally or how to structure a module, and to justify the choice you made. Unit testing as part of your normal workflow. Comfort with Git, pull-request workflows and code review. Nice To Have Experience with modular apps built from Swift packages and with project generation tools such as XcodeGen or Tuist. Experience with backend-driven or server-driven UI. UIKit experience and SwiftUI/UIKit interoperability. Analytics instrumentation (Google Analytics 4, Firebase) and A/B testing frameworks. Mobile CI/CD: fastlane, GitHub Actions, TestFlight and phased releases. Localization and right-to-left layout. Exposure to Kotlin Multiplatform or React Native modules inside a native app. Crash and performance monitoring tools, and snapshot or UI test automation. Our promise to talent At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.
